Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for t∈(−∞,∞), generate a vertical parabola that has its vertex at (0,0) and which passes through the point (−7,−7)?

a
x=−72t,y=−74t2
b
x=−74t2,y=−72t
c
x=−7t,y=−14t2
d
x=−7t2,y=−7t
e
 x=−72t,y=−7t2
